name: read_file
description: Read the entire UTF-8 contents of a repository-relative file. Use this tool when inspecting source files or repository guidance before making a change.

name: write_file
description: Write UTF-8 contents to a repository-relative file, creating the parent directories if necessary. This replaces the file contents. Inspect relevant existing contents before choosing a replacement.

name: run_command
description: Execute a command specified as an argument vector in the repository root. Use this tool for compilation and verification. Record the actual command outcome; a successful invocation is evidence only for the checks that it executed.
